description: The C_RelMod function block represents a collection of digital and analog objects that belong to a technological object, used in cement plant applications to organize and manage various objects.

inputs.name: SelFpD1
inputs.description: input value for object 1, used to set the JUMP variable with the object's AKZ

inputs.name: SelFpD2
inputs.description: input value for object 2, used to set the JUMP variable with the object's AKZ

outputs.name: Out_Sig
outputs.description: output value, used as a connection point for the next object
